title: Netflix Unveils the Official Trailer for 'Murder in Galicia'
summary: Netflix has unveiled the official trailer, poster and new images for Murder in Galicia, a limited series starring Tristán Ulloa (The Asunta Case, A Widow’s Game, Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine) and produced by Bambú Producciones.
